Definition: from G4012 and G5426; to think beyond, i.e. depreciate (contemn):--despise.
BiblicalUsage: Periphroneo means to think beyond, to despise, to look down on. Paul tells Titus to speak and exhort and rebuke with all authority, and let no man despise him.
TheologicalSignificance: I am sure that authority is not a matter of age: Titus was young, and Paul told him to speak so no man could despise him.
